label: Architecture
subgoals: Divide the flops by the internal chain count for the internal chain length
Compare it with the uncompressed chain length for the shift reduction
Expand tester bits through the decompressor into the internal chains

label: Data volume and ratio
subgoals: Write stimulus volume as patterns times channels times shift cycles
Divide uncompressed by compressed volume for the ratio
Exploit the low care-bit density of ATPG cubes

label: Pattern inflation
subgoals: Increase the compressed pattern count by the inflation factor
Recompute the volume ratio with the inflated pattern count
Mask unknown values before they reach the compactor
